citation: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information, Storm Events Database, 2014-2026. U.S. government work, public domain. https://www.ncdc.noaa.gov/stormevents/

events.title: Flash Flood near Oxford
events.description: 2 deaths. New Haven County. Two women women were swept away by rising floodwaters. Both have been reported as fatalities.

events.title: Flash Flood near Lyons
events.description: 1 death. Fairfield County. Pickup truck and camper submerged in Aspectuck River near Sawmill Road. Nearby bridge washed out. Deceased male located downstream from submerged vehicle.

events.title: Thunderstorm Wind near Willimantic
events.description: 1 death (indirect). Windham County. In Willimantic, a 53 year old male was killed by a falling tree.

events.title: Flood near Hotchkissville
events.description: 1 death. Litchfield County. A police vehicle was swept away by the swollen Weekeepeemee River at Jack's Bridge, resulting in the death of the Police Sergeant occupying the vehicle.

events.title: Thunderstorm Wind near Bridgeport
events.description: 1 death. Fairfield County. A 21 year old man was killed when a large tree limb and power lines fell onto his car in the northbound lanes of Park Avenue between Wilson Street and Merritt Street.

events.title: Thunderstorm Wind near Fairfield
events.description: 1 death. Fairfield County. Fallen tree into a car resulted in a fatality and another person having to be extracted from the car on Sturges Road in the Mill Plain section of Fairfield.

events.title: Thunderstorm Wind near New Fairfield
events.description: 1 death. Fairfield County. Tree fell on a car on Brush Hill Road, killing one person inside.

events.title: Thunderstorm Wind near Danbury
events.description: 1 death. Fairfield County. Tree fell on truck in Candlewood Lake area killing a man.

events.title: Thunderstorm Wind near Ridgewood
events.description: 1 death. New London County. Multiple trees were reported down along Pequot Avenue (just south of New London), including one tree falling onto a car, killing one person and injuring another. There was also minor damage to windows to one building.

events.title: Thunderstorm Wind near West Mystic
events.description: 1 death. New London County. A tree fell on a car along Flanders Road, near U. S. Route 1. The driver, and sole occupant of the vehicle, was killed.

events.title: Thunderstorm Wind near Park Lane
events.description: 1 death (indirect). Litchfield County. Broadcast Media reported that downed power lines resulted in a man exiting a vehicle to be electrocuted. The man died as a result of the injuries.
